message.content:
Using integration by parts:

Let \(u = \log(x)\) and \(dv = dx\).

Then \(du = \frac{1}{x} * dx\) and \(v = x\).

So,

\[
\int \log(x) dx = x * \log(x) - \int x * \frac{1}{x} dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - \int 1 dx
\]

\[
= x * \log(x) - x + C
\]

<answer>x*log(x) - x + C</answer>
